name: rea_catalog
description: Search the full REA tool catalog by keyword or target. Request a named tool's input schema before using rea_call.

query.description: Keywords or target, e.g. JavaScript, Android, native, process.

name.description: Exact tool name whose input schema should be returned.

name: rea_call
description: Invoke any REA tool by its exact catalog name with its original arguments. Discover its input schema with rea_catalog first.
